metric_definitions.Avg. monthly searches: Google Keyword Planner average monthly search volume for the selected target market.
metric_definitions.Competition: Google Ads advertiser competition level for the keyword.
metric_definitions.Competition (indexed value): Google Ads advertiser competition index on the source tool scale.
metric_definitions.Top of page bid (low range): Lower observed top-of-page bid range in the Google Ads account currency.
metric_definitions.Top of page bid (high range): Higher observed top-of-page bid range in the Google Ads account currency.
